keeper_rules.regression_2027: kept 2+ years → R10–15 up 3, R5–9 up 2, R1–4 up 1, from the 2027 draft. A keeper uses the matching-round pick. max_keepers is 3. If the team no longer owns a pick of that round, they cannot keep the player unless they acquired someone else's pick of that round.
keeper_rules.matching_pick: A keeper uses the matching-round pick. If a team no longer owns a pick of that round, it cannot keep the player unless it acquired someone else's pick of that round.
keeper_rules.years_travel_with_player: TRADE_RESETS_YEARS is false: years kept travel with the player unless a side deal says the rights sit with someone else.
keeper_rules.keepers_json: keepers.json is the start-of-2026-season keeper list (who was kept going into 2026). It is not current ownership and not current rights; its rights[] is empty.
keeper_rules.cost_basis: 2027 keep cost: keepers.json nextCostRound when present (includes regression), otherwise the player's 2026 draft round.
